analogy.rationale: BACE1 is a neuronal aspartyl protease with little expression or substrate flux in these non-neuronal cell lines, so beta-secretase inhibitors should elicit essentially no transcriptional response; gamma-secretase inhibitors share the amyloidogenic pathway but also act on broadly expressed Notch, and other protease/enzyme inhibitors are included only as weak, non-specific comparators.
